title: A2UI Core Client Conformance Test Suite Schema
description: JSON schema for validating YAML test suite files in conformance/suites/

name.description: Unique identifier for the test case.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of what the test case verifies.

initial_data.description: Initial data structure to load into the store before executing steps.

steps.description: Sequential operations to execute against the target implementation.

path.description: JSON Pointer path for get, set, or subscribe.

value.description: Value to set at path when action is set.

remove.description: When true in set, indicates removing the key or clearing the property.

listener_id.description: Unique handle name for referencing subscriptions across steps.

expect.description: Expected return value when action is get.

expect_undefined.description: When true, asserts that get returns undefined or null.

expect_error.description: Regular expression pattern or substring expected in the error message thrown by this step.

expect_updates.description: Chronological array of values expected to have been received by the specified listener_id.
